subject: Vendor setup: procurement intake commitments & MAP milestones — Ariba / Coupa
messages:
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Susan Turner <susan.turner@brightpointhealth.com>, ben_carter@redwood.com
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 14:32:00 -0700
Subject: Post-call recap and proposed MAP milestones (Ariba/Coupa intake)

Thanks again for the time today, Susan — good conversation. As promised, attaching a first-pass Mutual Action Plan focused on the procurement/vendor intake milestones so we can get BrightPoint live on Redwood with minimal friction. The attached MAP-draft-v0.1.pdf is intentionally compact; below are the high-priority milestones we discussed and the owners we recommended.

Summary (high level)
- Target commercial close: 2026-07-09 (customer requested EOM; we proposed two-week buffer)
- Primary procurement path: Ariba preferred, fallback: Coupa (BrightPoint IT will advise final choice)
- Key dependencies: vendor forms (profile + W-9), banking/ACH info, procurement portal registration (Ariba/Coupa), PO/contract signature

Proposed MAP milestones (owners / target date):
1) Supplier intake form submitted (owner: BrightPoint procurement / Michael) — target: 2026-06-18
2) Vendor profile & W-9 uploaded to portal (owner: BrightPoint procurement) — target: 2026-06-20
3) Redwood sends supplier profile + onboarding packet & Ariba/Coupa invite (owner: Vivek / Redwood ops) — target: 2026-06-16 (we can do same-day invite)
4) Payment setup (banking + ACH) confirmed (owner: BrightPoint finance) — target: 2026-06-24
5) Contract countersign & PO issued (owner: BrightPoint legal / procurement) — target: 2026-07-02
6) Production onboarding & test calls (owner: Redwood CS / Marissa) — target: 2026-07-07

Immediate asks for your team
- Can you confirm the primary portal (Ariba vs Coupa)? If Ariba, please provide procurement contact and supplier ID if already created.
- Please upload your W-9 and vendor banking stub to the supplier profile, or send via secure link.
- Confirm whether BrightPoint requires a vendor packet (we've attached a vendor_profile_template.pdf you can fill)

Attachments: MAP-draft-v0.1.pdf, vendor_profile_template.pdf (fillable), call-recording-20260615.mp3 (internal reference).

If you prefer, I can open the Ariba supplier invite and walk Michael through the first submission live on Thursday.

Thanks — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com | (415) 555-0123

From: Susan Turner <susan.turner@brightpointhealth.com>

Cc: procurement@brightpointhealth.com, Michael Suarez <msuarez@brightpointhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 15 Jun 2026 16:07:00 -04:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and proposed MAP milestones (Ariba/Coupa intake)

Thanks, Vivek — appreciate the clear recap. Quick answers and follow-ups below: 

1) Primary portal: Ariba. We do not yet have a supplier ID for Redwood (we usually create the supplier record once we have the initial vendor packet).
2) I'll loop in Michael Suarez (procurement) who will own the supplier intake and W-9 upload. I've CC'd him here.
3) Net terms: our finance team prefers Net 45 for new vendors; can you confirm Redwood's standard? If Net 30 is required for pricing tiers, we can escalate to finance.

Michael — Vivek included a MAP and onboarding template. Can you confirm you can complete the vendor_profile_template and upload the W-9 by end of week? If you prefer, we can do the Ariba invite and intake tomorrow afternoon (we have an opening at 2pm ET).

Looking forward to moving this along — Susan
Susan Turner
Director, Procurement | BrightPoint Health
susan.turner@brightpointhealth.com | +1 212-555-0199

From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek.kulkarni@redwood.com>

Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: Tue, 16 Jun 2026 08:14:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Post-call recap and proposed MAP milestones (Ariba/Coupa intake)

Thanks Michael — copying Ben (sales engineering) and Marissa (CS) so we have ops + technical coverage.

Below is a succinct, action-oriented version of the MAP we can attach to the PO/contract so everyone has visibility. I recommend we keep target commercial close as 2026-07-09 unless BrightPoint wants to accelerate.

MAP (action items / owner / acceptance criteria / date)
- Redwood: Send supplier packet & Ariba invite (owner: Vivek) — acceptance: invite sent + initial profile fields prefilled — by 2026-06-16 (DONE)
- BrightPoint procurement: Complete supplier intake form in Ariba (owner: Michael) — acceptance: supplier record created with company tax ID + contact — by 2026-06-18
- BrightPoint finance: Upload W-9 and bank details (owner: BrightPoint finance) — acceptance: document visible in Ariba / vendor portal — by 2026-06-20
- Redwood ops: Provide invoice remit + payment instructions and confirm preferred payment term (owner: Redwood finance / Ben) — acceptance: finance confirms Net terms in SOW — by 2026-06-22
- Legal/Contract: Sign SOW and issue PO (owner: BrightPoint legal/procurement) — acceptance: countersigned SOW + PO number supplied — by 2026-07-02
- Onboarding: Test calls and production handoff (owner: Marissa / Redwood CS) — acceptance: successful test tokens and latency report — by 2026-07-07

Notes / dependencies: 
- If Ariba requires additional registration items (e.g., diversity certificate), please flag as early as possible.
- For Net45 requests: Ben, can you confirm pricing impact (if any) and whether we need a finance exception?

I've uploaded a short supplier packet to the Drive link here: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1AbcDefGHIjK_map-draft. If you prefer DocuSign for the SOW, we can circulate that after the vendor profile is live.

Attachments: vendor_profile_template.pdf (fillable).

Best — Vivek
Vivek Kulkarni
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Vivek / Susan — attaching our W-9 (brightpoint_W-9.pdf). We filled the top-level vendor profile fields in Ariba but have not completed banking details yet — finance requires the supplier portal entry and vendor remittance fields before we share ACH (we can provide a banking stub once the vendor record is verified).

We can take the Ariba intake slot today at 2pm ET if Vivek or Ben can join — Michael will have the procurement form open. Regarding Net45, finance confirmed they will keep Net45 for new vendors; if Redwood has a discount tied to Net30, please let us know and Michael and I can route to procurement leadership for review.

Next steps: 
- Michael to finish Ariba intake by 2026-06-18 (aiming for today slot)
- BrightPoint finance to provide banking stub once record verified — by 2026-06-24
- Redwood to confirm payment terms and send final SOW for signature — target 2026-07-02

Thanks — Michael
